basic_info.description: Top Floor, Penthouse-level One Bedroom floor plan with Office/Den at SoMa Grand! Luxurious appointments include designer Kitchen outfitted with Studio Becker Wenge Cabinetry, Cambria Quartz Counters & Bosch Appliances including Gas Range. Living Room offers picturesque southern and western city outlooks. In-home laundry. Accommodating floor plan with bonus Office/Den. SOMA Grand amenities include: bi-monthly housekeeping, concierge, 24 hour security, and hot premium coffee service in the full service lobby. The 5th floor Park level has a gym, hot tub, barbeque, fire pit, Clubroom with full kitchen and Wellness room for private instruction or massage.
